source_of_truth: ouuut-v2 design-lock + live computed styles at 1440px, 2026-10-21. japan.ouuut.com must read as the same publication as ouuut.com.
style: Tokyo Expedition Magazine Editorial / ouuut family. Two themes only: sage (day) and dark (night). Zero structural lines.
theme_boot: localStorage pj-theme wins; otherwise sage 06:00-17:59, dark otherwise. No mono.

typography.serif: Instrument Serif 400 / Noto Serif JP 700 / Noto Serif SC 700
typography.sans: Geist 400-500 / Noto Sans JP 500 / Noto Sans SC 500

home.band: Six plates, three across, two rows; grid gap 16px. Two columns ≤1199px, one column ≤1000px (horizontal card), vertical card ≤640px.
home.plate_box: aspect-ratio 1000/340 at ≥641px, and back to 1000/680 at ≤640px where the card turns vertical — every plate is a build-time SVG at viewBox 1000×760, centred, never stretched (preserveAspectRatio meet). The wide box ratio is deliberate: it letterboxes the plates to 40-47% of the box width (~100-113px of gutter per side) at ≥1200px, which is the price of six plates inside one screen, not an accident. The shipped labels inside those plates (.micro/.legend 22px, .ward 24px user units) render at 4-4.5px there, as they already did at 4-7px before this round.
home.preview_plates: weather and news have no feed yet: the foot reads「予告」/「预告」/「Soon」without the 開く arrow, the card is a div rather than an a, and hover neither lifts nor tints it.
home.h1: clamp(30px,3.1vw,44px) EN / clamp(28px,2.8vw,40px) JA·ZH, line-height 1.06 EN / 1.24 JA / 1.22 ZH; the ≤640px override is clamp(32px,8.7vw,45px) / clamp(30px,8.2vw,41px). px+v.w at every breakpoint, no rem: the cover must not grow when the browser's default font size is raised (a 20px root used to add 25px to the cover and push row 2 under the fold — found by the 2026-10-25 review), while every other text size on this page is already px.
home.measured_2026_10_25: Verified on the built artifact (playwright, cache off), ja/en/zh x root font 16px and 20px: band bottom 887-893px at 1920x945 (52-65px of room) and 879-893px at 1440x900 (7-21px of room). 1280x800 cannot hold six plates (it wants ~860px) and scrolls by design. The first reading of 943px held only for ja at a 16px root: a review measured 974px at a 20px root, which is what moved the cover h1 to px+v.w (see h1 above).
home.removed_2026_10_25: the cover eyebrow line「JAPAN.OUUUT.COM · 2000—2026」(key cover.kicker) is gone from the cover.

notes: Homepage runs six prod-style plates, three across and two down, in this order: weather, quake, crime, cabinet, housing, news. The four chapter plates are links; the weather and news plates are previews (no live feed), so they carry「予告」instead of「開く」and are not links.
Charts use one signal hue per theme; no rainbow categorical palette.
Motion: grain, scroll progress, header scrolled, .rv reveal, theme view-transition. No custom cursor/particles.
